user_journeys.description: Navigate through categories to view a specific high-resolution wallpaper.
user_journeys.business_value: Ensures users can discover and access specific content categories and individual assets.
user_journeys.user_persona: Casual user looking for desktop backgrounds

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: Unsplash Wallpaper Click (1) - Complete User Journey
proposed_scenarios.description: Verify that a user can navigate from the Unsplash homepage to the Wallpapers category and select a specific wallpaper to view its details.
proposed_scenarios.workflow_narrative: The agent started on the Unsplash homepage, clicked on the 'Wallpapers' category link in the navigation, and then selected a specific wallpaper titled 'Rippling blue water surface' to open its detailed view.
playwright_implementation_guidance: The navigation to the specific wallpaper uses a descriptive role-based selector which is robust.
Ensure the page is fully loaded before clicking the category link as Unsplash has a heavy image load.
The final verification should check for the presence of the photo detail view URL pattern.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify users can successfully browse categories and open individual wallpaper pages.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a user, I want to browse the wallpapers category and click on an image so that I can see it in full detail.

detailed_steps.description: Click on the 'Wallpapers' link in the top navigation bar
detailed_steps.verification_point: URL changes to the wallpapers topic page

detailed_steps.description: Click on the specific wallpaper 'Rippling blue water surface'

expected_results: User successfully navigates to the Wallpapers topic page
User successfully opens the detailed view for 'Rippling blue water surface'
The final URL matches the specific photo ID 'LYwdBEJc6Y'
edge_cases_to_test: Wallpaper link not visible due to infinite scroll
Network timeout during high-res image loading
Category link being obscured by a promotional banner
